config.seedmean: mean predictions per row before calculating error; not mean losses
config.closed: mean of raw act_vent==0 across 24hours; closed if fraction>=.8
config.concentration: rank daily SSE descending within segment; ties farm/day ascending; top10 and top65 capped at segment days
groups: farm x pass within each segment
closed>=.8 vs rest within each segment
closed x farm x pass within each segment
config.inference: no hypothesis tests; no causal or information-absence claim
config.nd0_original_sealed: mean raw act_circfan<10 AND ventzero fraction>.85; distinct from alternative closed>=.8
config.sd0_error_group: closed>=.8 days; OVER daybias>=.15, UNDER daybias<=-.15, OK otherwise; purely diagnostic

r3s: Existing public S.outer CSV has no r3s column; Claude ND0 R3S numbers remain log-only provenance
limitations: y-based high/ordinary and top-error ranking are diagnostic only
daily vent==0 grouping is association; severity/season/farm confounded
raw daily control summary uses complete day for analysis; not an inference feature
